lines.zh: 我在开阔地走，专挑没遮挡的地方。
lines.en: I keep to open ground, where nothing blocks me.

lines.zh: 我抬起双臂，试了试分量。
lines.en: I lift both arms and test their weight.

lines.zh: 我慢慢踱着，像在丈量场地。
lines.en: I pace, as if measuring the field.
I step over a ditch.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，但地面撑不住我。
lines.en: I am not fast, but the ground struggles under me.
I follow the riverbed, hunting sheep.

lines.zh: 我抬手把挡路的树推开。
lines.en: I push a tree out of my way.

lines.zh: 我停下来，看了看自己的拳头。
lines.en: I stop and look at my own fist.
I stand with my hands at my sides.

lines.zh: 我一抬双臂，就试试分量。
lines.en: I raise both arms and test their weight.
I look up at the sky and do not move.

lines.zh: 我脚下的土已经被踩实了。
lines.en: The soil under me is packed hard.

lines.zh: 站久了，脚下的土都陷下去。
lines.en: Standing this long, the soil sinks beneath me.

lines.zh: 我抬手摸了摸自己的胸口。
lines.en: I touch my own chest.

lines.zh: 我的影子在身后拉得很长。
lines.en: My shadow stretches long behind me.
I slowly close my fist.
I hold still, like a wall.
I tilt my head toward distant bleating.

lines.zh: 我身上有旧伤，已经硬了。
lines.en: An old wound on me has gone hard.

lines.zh: 我站着，比旁边的石头还稳。
lines.en: I stand steadier than the stone beside me.

lines.zh: 得弯腰，才装得下你的影子。
lines.en: I have to stoop before your shadow fits my eye.
You are taller than a sheep. Not by much.
I raise a hand; you step back.

lines.zh: 我朝你走了一步，地面震动。
lines.en: I take one step; the ground shakes.
I laugh. It does not sound like laughing.
I raise both hands.
You retreat. I do not chase.

lines.zh: 我还没决定要不要动手。
lines.en: I have not decided whether to act.
I rub my chin with the back of a finger.
You stand like a tense animal.

lines.zh: 你比我见过的羊更耐看。
lines.en: You are better to look at than any sheep.
I tilt my head and wait for you to finish.
I shift my feet and plant myself.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，地面凹了一点。
lines.en: I give half a step; the ground dents.
A crack has opened in my shoulder bone.

lines.zh: 砸地的拳头，还会再抬起来。
lines.en: The fist that cracked the ground rises again.
I clench my fist again.

lines.zh: 这点痛，连挠痒都算不上。
lines.en: That barely counts as a scratch.
You dare cut my hide?
What leaks out of me isn't blood. It's spite.

lines.zh: 再来一下，我就把你砸进地里。
lines.en: One more hit and I'll pound you into the dirt.

lines.zh: 我一砸地，石头就掀起来。
lines.en: One slam and the stone rises.

lines.zh: 你把东西放下，我没有动。
lines.en: You set it down. I do not move.

lines.zh: 砸地一下，冲击波贴着地面跑。
lines.en: One pound, and the shockwave runs low.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，不够我一口。
lines.en: What's in your hand is less than a mouthful.
I toss it back to you.
Kind of you. It changes nothing.
Do not try to trade this for your life.
The smell of flesh... I can taste it already.
You hit me and bounce off.
I barely shift.
You hit my knee and back away.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，声音很闷，地面裂了。
lines.en: We collided with a dull thud; the ground cracked.
I look down, mildly curious.
A pit forms under my feet.
Don't stand by my feet. You'll break.

lines.zh: 撞上来？你倒是很有胆量。
lines.en: Running into me? You've got nerve.

lines.zh: 另一位也在开阔地等我。
lines.en: Another waits for me in the open.

lines.zh: 我们一起踩着地，听它响。
lines.en: We stamp the ground and listen.

lines.zh: 我们一起朝羊群的方向走。
lines.en: We head toward the sheep together.

lines.zh: 她站在我左边，那是她的位置。
lines.en: She takes my left. That is her place.
There is nothing wasted between us.
She hauls a stone over to me.

lines.zh: 分开时，她只是点了一下头。
lines.en: When we part, she only nods.

lines.zh: 这里不需要同伴，只需要食物。
lines.en: No mate here. Only meat.
It is not what I am after.
I toss it back to you.
I turn it over in my hand.
I set it beside me.
It is so small I almost lose it.

lines.zh: 我把它碾进地上的泥里。
lines.en: I grind it into the mud.
Whatever's in your hands is mine now.

lines.zh: 拾起这块骨头，当作你的墓碑。
lines.en: I'll pick up this bone and plant it as your grave marker.
I raise both arms above my shoulders.
I stamp one foot down.
The ground begins to shake. You should jump.
I have chosen where to bring the blow.

lines.zh: 你退到开阔地，正合我意。
lines.en: You back into the open. Exactly right.
Jump, or take it.
I turn slowly to face you.
My fist is clenched as tight as it goes.

lines.zh: 这一整片地都在我脚下。
lines.en: This whole field is under my feet.
I begin to gather force.
There is no cover behind you.
I take my first step toward you.
I lift my arm past my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我一步步压过去，地面在抖。
lines.en: I press in, and the ground trembles.
I am in no hurry. I have strength enough.
You cut me; the wound is shallow.
I raise my hand, then bring it down.
You jumped. Good.
I turn as you do.
I wait for you to land.
I herd you toward the middle.
I raise both arms; the ground splits.
Are you counting my heartbeats.
I collapse the way back.
Soon you will have nowhere to jump.
The ground under you is groaning.

lines.zh: 我每一次落脚都靠近一点。
lines.en: Each footfall brings me closer.
I raise my fist higher.
This one will be ugly.

lines.zh: 我双拳砸地，冲击波推出去。
lines.en: I slam both fists down; a shockwave rolls out.
I bring a fist down; clods fly.

lines.zh: 我抬脚踩下，地面凹成坑。
lines.en: I stomp; the ground caves into a pit.

lines.zh: 这一拳打偏了，砸出自己的坑。
lines.en: The punch misses and digs its own crater.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的衣领把你提起来。
lines.en: I grab your collar and lift you.

lines.zh: 我用肩膀撞你，你退了很远。
lines.en: I ram you with my shoulder; you go far.
The blow sends you rolling twice.
I raise my hand and strike again.

lines.zh: 冲击波推开，你腾空而起。
lines.en: My shockwave flings you off your feet.

lines.zh: 这一击让地面裂了一条线。
lines.en: This blow opens a line in the ground.
Breathing hard, I still raise my fist.
You jump clear; I turn after you.

lines.zh: 我从地上升起来，土往下掉。
lines.en: I rise from the ground; soil slides off me.
I straighten up first, then look around.
I raise both hands before my eyes.
It is open here. Just right.
I stamp the ground to test it.

lines.zh: 我吼了一声，鸟都飞走了。
lines.en: I roar once, and the birds scatter.
I slowly work my shoulders loose.
I can already smell sheep.

lines.zh: 我朝有声音的方向转过去。
lines.en: I turn toward the sound.

lines.zh: 我脚下的土被踩出一个圈。
lines.en: The soil under me is pressed into a ring.
I begin measuring this ground.

lines.zh: 我知道这里只有我一个。
lines.en: I know I am the only one here.
I am in no hurry. First, I stand.
I tear off a scrap of my ruined coat.
I take my place at the center of the open ground.

lines.zh: 我等着第一个敢靠近的。
lines.en: I wait for the first to dare approach.

lines.zh: 我把一拳砸在自己的掌心。
lines.en: I drive one fist into the other palm.

lines.zh: 我开始朝最近的活物走。
lines.en: I start toward the nearest living thing.

lines.zh: 我抬脚，把一块石头踢开。
lines.en: I lift a foot and kick a stone away.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地转过头，看向你。
lines.en: I turn my head slowly toward you.
Fire burns my hide. I do not swat it.

lines.zh: 我从高处砸下，地面陷了。
lines.en: I fall from above; the ground sinks.

lines.zh: 水到我的腰，我却动不了。
lines.en: Water reaches my waist, and I cannot move.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀退，我撑住了。
lines.en: The blast shoves me back; I hold.
An arrow sticks in my shoulder like a thorn.
That light crawls into my bones.

lines.zh: 雷打在我头顶，我全身一震。
lines.en: Lightning hits my crown; my whole body jerks.

lines.zh: 脚下的地没了，我往下沉。
lines.en: The ground is gone; I sink.
